snippet.title: Wipeout Game Show MS-DOS Edition
snippet.description:
A play through of the MS-DOS edition of Wipeout! A game show hosted by the late Peter Tomarken (Press Your Luck).

This one never caught on as much, but I always enjoyed it. Pretty fun game here.
